fusions.name: Braced Shove
fusions.desc: A braced bite that deals 14 damage, leaves the target 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds and knocks it back 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Ledge Drop
fusions.desc: Costs 4% of your maximum health. Drops onto a target up to 5 tiles away and deals 8 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach, with a 30% chance to leave it [Pinned] for 1.5 seconds.

fusions.name: Will Not Budge
fusions.desc: For 3 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you.

fusions.name: Planted Footing
fusions.desc: Your armour rises by 12%, and you have 8% physical resistance.
